quests.title: Unexpected Commission: Epilogue

dialogue.t: Oh? You finished sorting already? That went much faster then I expected.
Now then, what would you like in return, cutie? You freed up my whole afternoon, helping me with that. How about we spend it together?

dialogue.sit: I'd like to ask about these books...

dialogue.t: Oh, that's all? Well, don't worry. I won't forget.
Ah, so you noticed, too. Such strange names, and even stranger contents...
Not to mention, this is the largest library in northern Teyvat, and I didn't recognize a single title on the list. I just don't see how that's possible.
Trouble, I presume? I think I'll steer clear, if it's all the same to you.
Besides, if a book exists in this world, then there's a place for them in this library.
Better for them to remain here than end up in the hands of someone more... suspect.
Anyway, here's your payment. Thanks again for all the help.

quests.description: Now that Lisa’s commission is complete, you’d better ask her for your payment…
